overview.description: The PGIM Securitized Income ETF (PINC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund is an actively managed portfolio of global securitized fixed income securities, selected using top-down economic analysis and bottom-up research. PINC was launched on Jun 1, 2026 and is issued by PGIM.
